title: Exact Tetragonal Coordinates for the Genus-4 M23 Quotient
subtitle: Symmetric Principal Parts, Exact Arithmetic Closure, and the Seven-Band Support Law
description:
Symmetric Principal Parts, Exact Arithmetic Closure, and the Seven-Band Support Law

Exact degree-4 coordinates for the genus-4 quotient in the HJLPPZ M23 construction. The article constructs and proves smooth the required Z_31 normalization model, proves a geometric seven-band support law, a primitive bidegree-(4,23) characteristic-zero equation, an exact PGL2(Q) transition to the symmetric principal-part frame, 22-prime coefficientwise validation, an exhaustive held-out p=1013 fiber comparison, and a general prime-degree support-polygon law. The accompanying archive provides executable certificates, exact data, recorded independent finite-field outputs, and checksum manifests. The logically separate appendix proves global ordinary-height minimality among all integer translates and over the full rational fractional-linear PGL2(Q) orbit of the Example 3.7 generator; only arbitrary primitive field generators outside that orbit remain beyond the claim.
